manifest.name: @dsh-external/dsh-image-tiler
manifest.description: DSH 高清图自动切片插件：发送前把大图切成 ≤800×800 小图，附带简洁设置页。
manifest.author: TIKO

bundle.text:
# dsh-image-tiler bundle 层：把高清图切片插件插入 DSH loader。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-image-tiler
      name: '@dsh-external/dsh-image-tiler'
      config: {}

readme.text:
> 简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DSH 高清图自动切片插件：发送前把大图切成 **≤800×800 的小图**，绕过 DeepSeek API 后端把图片统一压到 800×800 导致的细节丢失。

- 仅对 DeepSeek provider（`deepseek` / `deepseek-official`）生效。
- 自动在 `agent/pre-step` 改写用户新上传的图片消息：读原图 → sharp 切片（默认 10% 重叠）→ 保存为 DSH 附件 → 替换为多张图片块。
- 已 ≤800px 的图片、GIF 原样透传。
- 插件设置 → “高清图切片”卡片，可开关、调切片边长和重叠率。

> ⚠️ 构建脚本依赖本机存在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）源码 checkout。公开环境请在安装/构建前准备好 DSH checkout，并通过 `DSH_CHECKOUT` 指向它。

```bash

readme.section: 1. 准备 DSH checkout 后执行：
readme.text: DSH_CHECKOUT=<deepseek-harness-checkout> npm install
npm run build

dev_inject_plugin <本目录>
```

如果没有设置 `DSH_CHECKOUT`，构建脚本会尝试探测常见路径，例如：

```text
~/Downloads/deepseek-harness-master
~/dsh-harness
~/dsh
~/.dsh/dsh-harness
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `tileSize` | `800` | 切片边长（px），64~2000 |
| `overlap` | `0.1` | 相邻切片重叠比例，0~0.5 |

配置写入 DSH 设置文件（namespace `image-tiler`），设置页通过 `/image-tiler/api/config` 读写，仅允许本机回环访问。

readme.section: ⚠️ 使用前需要调高 DSH 图片准入上限
readme.text:
DSH 默认在**上传阶段**就会拒绝任一边超过 `2000px` 的图片，插件还没机会切片。要支持 4K 原图，请在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中加入：

```yaml
- id: attachment-local
  config:
    maxImageBytes: 20971520
    maxImagesPerMessage: 30

修改后 DSH 通常会热重载；如果没生效，重启 DSH Web。

- 只处理用户新上传/新消息里的图片；`read_image` 工具结果里的图片暂不处理。
- 若切片过程中出错，会保留原图并记录警告，不阻断对话。
- 公开环境构建需要 DSH checkout；GitHub Actions 当前只做轻量 typecheck + 单元测试，不执行完整构建。

> English | [简体中文](README.md)

A DSH high-resolution image tiler plugin: before sending an image, it slices large images into smaller tiles of **≤800×800** to avoid detail loss caused by the DeepSeek API backend downscaling everything to 800×800.

- Applies only to DeepSeek providers (`deepseek` / `deepseek-official`).
- Hooks into `agent/pre-step`, reads newly uploaded images, slices them with sharp (default 10% overlap), saves them as DSH attachments, and replaces the original image blocks with tiles.
- Images already ≤800px and GIFs are passed through unchanged.
- Adds a "高清图切片" settings card where you can enable/disable the plugin, set tile size, and overlap ratio.

> ⚠️ The build script requires a local DeepSeek Harness (DSH) source checkout. Public users should prepare a DSH checkout and point `DSH_CHECKOUT` to it.

```bash
DSH_CHECKOUT=<deepseek-harness-checkout> npm install
npm run build
dev_inject_plugin <this-directory>
```

If `DSH_CHECKOUT` is not set, the build script probes common paths such as:

```text
~/Downloads/deepseek-harness-master
~/dsh-harness
~/dsh
~/.dsh/dsh-harness

| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `tileSize` | `800` | Tile edge length in px (64–2000) |
| `overlap` | `0.1` | Overlap ratio between adjacent tiles (0–0.5) |

- Only images in newly entered user messages are processed; images returned by `read_image` are not handled yet.
- If tiling fails, the original image is kept and a warning is logged; the conversation is not blocked.
- Public builds require a DSH checkout; GitHub Actions performs a lightweight typecheck + unit tests only, not a full build.
